_schema.purpose: Non-secret identity of Gravitee-only realms, keyed by environment then REALM_KEY. Read by configs/setup.js at startup and by applyRealmKeyOverride() in util/gateway.util.ts when test data pins a REALM_KEY.
_schema.realmId: string (required) - REALM_ID used for machine tokens
_schema.subjectId: string (required) - SUBJECT_ID of the realm's machine user
